versions.changelog: v1.0.3: Git checkout detection (.git probe), running dir vs npm global dir consistency check, npm prefix writability check with fix instructions, auto-sync to non-consist dir after npm install, install type validation before backup to avoid wasted backup.

v1.0.2: Dynamic path detection (systemd ExecStart / npm root -g), npm prefix writability check, entry file check relaxed (dist/*.js), git checkout install not supported with clear message, fixed typo OPENCLAIR→OPENCLAW. Added known limitations to SKILL.md.
v1.0.1: Fully dynamic path detection (npm root, systemd service name, openclaw directory). No hardcoded paths. Script auto-detects all installation locations.
Initial release: zero-downtime OpenClaw upgrade with backup/rollback, release notes check, and user confirmation
